from pathlib import Path
import tempfile,torch,pytest
from Models import BasicModel
from test_sentence_compose import test_real_packed_seals_train_before_the_next_sentence
commit=BasicModel._commit_sentence
def checked(self,*args):
    result=commit(self,*args)
    counts=[len(row) for row in self.symbolSpace.discourse._inter_context_occurrences]
    print('CONTEXT_COUNTS',args[1],counts,flush=True)
    assert all(count >= 1 for count in counts)
    return result
BasicModel._commit_sentence=checked
with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as patch:
    test_real_packed_seals_train_before_the_next_sentence(Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()),patch,False)
